summary: ORIX Corporation filed a 6-K announcing it will sell all shares in its consolidated subsidiary, ORIX Bank Corporation, to Daiwa Next Bank, Ltd., a subsidiary of Daiwa Securities Group Inc. The sale is structured as a share transfer agreement; no price per share, premium, or total value was disclosed. ORIX's board determined the sale is optimal for ORIX Bank's growth amid a rising interest rate environment. The deal is subject to regulatory approvals. Watch for closing conditions and the impact on ORIX's capital efficiency targets.
